shell.title: Your words stay yours.
shell.description: Blind Journal is a zero-knowledge journal designed so only you can unlock and read what you write.
shell.privacyDescription: Your password and encryption keys stay with you. The server authenticates your account and stores encrypted journal data without access to its contents.

signIn.title: Sign in to your journal
signIn.description: Enter your credentials to continue to your private writing space.

createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.description: Choose the credentials you will use to unlock your private journal.
createAccount.usernameHint: Use 3–24 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

success.signedIn: Welcome back. Your journal is ready.
success.accountCreated: Your account is ready. Welcome to Blind Journal.

errors.usernameInvalid: Use 3–24 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is already in use.
errors.passwordTooShort: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
errors.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in to access your journal.
